The documents indicate that Calder & Wynne's hourly rates are not inclusive of VAT. The engagement letter states, "VAT is added at the applicable rate" [1]. This suggests that VAT is added to the hourly rates, meaning the rates are exclusive of VAT.

The documents in this matter do not answer that.

evidence.quote: VAT is added at the applicable rate

items.question: When is the Kestrel storage fee invoiced?
items.answer:
The Kestrel storage fee is invoiced on the first business day of each month. This is stated in the amended clause 3.1 of the Kestrel Storage Services Agreement, which was updated by Amendment No. 1 [1].

Before the amendment, the original clause 3.1 also stated that the fee was invoiced on the first business day of each month [2].

evidence.quote: Client shall pay a monthly storage fee of EUR 4,600, invoiced on the first business day of each month
evidence.document_title: Amendment No. 1 to the Kestrel storage agreement

evidence.quote: Client shall pay a monthly storage fee of EUR 4,000, invoiced on the first business day of each month

items.question: Which clause of the storage agreement did Amendment No. 1 replace?
items.answer: Amendment No. 1 replaced Clause 3.1 of the Kestrel Storage Services Agreement. The amendment states, "Clause 3.1 of the Storage Services Agreement is deleted and replaced with: Client shall pay a monthly storage fee of EUR 4,600, invoiced on the first business day of each month" [1].

evidence.quote: Clause 3.1 of the Storage Services Agreement is deleted and replaced with: Client shall pay a monthly storage fee of EUR 4,600, invoiced on the first business day of each month
evidence.document_title: Amendment No. 1 to the Kestrel storage agreement

items.question: What was Jonas Ekberg's job at Kestrel?
items.answer: Jonas Ekberg's job at Kestrel was that of a shift supervisor. This is stated in his witness statement, which says, "I was the supervisor on duty on the night the chiller in Hall 3 failed" [1].
